spanish: y el turbante de lino fino, y los adornos de las tiaras de lino fino, y los calzones del lino, lino fino retorcido,

findings.issue: Masculine plural construct noun is a head-dress; «adornos» is generic decoration and drops the head-dress.
Definite feminine plural noun is a cap or bonnet; «tiaras» narrows it to a crown or diadem.
Both nouns are absolute, so shesh is not in construct with the caps; «de» assigns the fine linen to the tiaras.

notes: Object markers are unexpressed; turbante, calzones, both linen words, and retorcido match number and the hophal passive.
